dict.string: Spatial Take finds the room's walls, floor and tables to line its map of the room up with the real one, and to place answers on real surfaces.
Spatial Take uses your hands to know what you point at or touch when you ask.
Spatial Take listens when you tap the microphone, to ask the agent by voice.
Spatial Take turns what you say into the question it asks the agent.
Spatial Take talks to the Spatial Take agent running on your Mac.
